versions.changelog: Add runtime estimation before committing to long runs (§4)

Initial release of high-performance-coding skill.

- Encodes universal principles for writing and optimizing performance-critical code, such as resource-aware parallelism, async pipeline design, and GPU acceleration.
- Triggers when users mention keywords like performance, optimize, scale, concurrency, speed up, throughput, latency, memory bound, CPU bound, checkpoint, resume, and related terms.
- Explains how to identify bottlenecks (compute-bound vs bandwidth-bound) and optimize accordingly.
- Provides best-practice patterns for CPU, memory, IO, and GPU-bound workloads, as well as container-based pipelines.
- Covers parallelism strategies, memory efficiency, async design, and interruption-tolerant computation.
- Emphasizes practical guidance and resource awareness when scaling or optimizing critical code paths.
